original.statement: Upgrading to Karpenter 1.0.0+ introduces v1 APIs and requires following the v1 Migration Upgrade Procedure; stored v1beta1 manifests must be migrated to v1 before v1beta1 stops being served at v1.1.0.

decision.reason: [ev-bfb089d90d84] says "Do not upgrade to 1.0.0+ without referencing the v1 Migration Upgrade Procedure". That applies to every upgrade that starts below 1.0.0, so edge-from-version in-range "<1.0.0" captures exactly the exposed environments. The v1beta1 manifest migration it also mentions only affects environments coming from pre-1.0 releases, so it is covered by the same condition. P3's alternative (v1beta1 GVKs in use) would miss pre-1.0 environments that still have to follow the upgrade procedure.
